segments.name: Mineral exploration
segments.description: Acquires and explores precious metal, zinc and other base metal mineral properties, seeking to advance them toward development or sale.
segments.evidence: Solitario's primary focus is on the acquisition and exploration of precious metal, zinc and other base metal exploration mineral properties.

revenueModel.text: Buyers pay for mineral properties and royalties it sells, an infrequent and inconsistent source of revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Solitario has recorded revenue in the past from the sale of mineral properties, including the sale of certain mineral royalties.
